title: Become a UGC Creator in India, Get Paid | TrendBag
description: Become a UGC creator in India with no follower minimum. Shoot Reels for fashion brands and get paid in ₹ per approved video. Join free and apply to briefs.
h1: Become a UGC creator in India and get paid per video
lede: Fashion brands on TrendBag pay for the video, not your follower count. Pick a brief, shoot a Reel, and get paid in ₹ once the brand approves it.

sections.heading: How to start as a UGC creator in India on TrendBag
sections.intro: Six steps from sign-up to your first payout. No agency, no follower threshold.

items.title: Sign up
items.body: Download the TrendBag app on Android or iOS, or open app.trendbag.in, and create your creator account.

items.title: Build your profile with 2 samples
items.body: Add a short bio, your style and two sample videos. Your profile is your portfolio, and it is what brands see when they review applications.

items.title: Take the UGC basics lesson
items.body: A free 15-minute lesson covers hooks, lighting and framing. Complete the test brief after it to earn a verified badge on your profile.

items.title: Apply to briefs
items.body: Browse briefs from fashion brands and apply to the ones that fit you. Brands can also invite you directly.

items.title: Shoot and submit
items.body: If the brief includes product, it is shipped to you. Shoot the video, submit it in the app, and handle up to 2 rounds of revisions if the brand asks.

items.title: Get paid
items.body: You are paid in ₹ for each approved video. Withdraw to your verified Indian bank account once your balance reaches ₹100.

sections.heading: Why UGC work on TrendBag suits new creators

items.title: No follower minimum
items.body: UGC jobs are about the video you make, not the audience you have. A creator with a few hundred followers can apply to the same briefs.

items.title: Payment funded upfront
items.body: The brand funds the payment before the job starts, so approved work gets paid.

items.title: No endless waiting
items.body: If a brand does not respond within 72 hours of your submission, the video is auto-approved.

items.title: Fashion-first briefs
items.body: Briefs come mostly from Indian D2C fashion labels: hauls, try-ons, GRWM, styling and unboxing Reels.

items.title: You keep ownership
items.body: Your videos stay yours. Each brief states how the brand may use the video, and you license it on those terms.

sections.heading: Ground rules for every UGC brief
sections.intro: Simple rules that keep your videos safe to publish and your payouts clean.

items.title: Original audio or royalty-free music
items.body: Use your own voice or royalty-free tracks only, so the video can be posted and boosted without copyright claims.

items.title: Consent from anyone featured
items.body: If a friend or family member appears in your video, get their consent before you submit.

items.title: Disclosure is built in
items.body: The paid partnership label is applied when the video goes live, in line with ASCI disclosure guidelines.

items.title: Usage rights are in the brief
items.body: Each brief spells out where and how long the brand can use your video. Read it before you apply.

sections.heading: More than jobs: Minis in the TrendBag app
sections.intro: The same app you use for briefs also has style tools for your own content.

items.title: AI stylist
items.body: Ask for outfit ideas and styling suggestions when you plan a shoot.

items.title: Wardrobe
items.body: Keep track of what you own so you can plan looks quickly.

items.title: Outfit tools
items.body: Put together and save outfits for your next video.

faq.q: How to become a UGC creator in India?
faq.a: To become a UGC creator in India, start by making a few short sample videos that show you can present a product clearly: a try-on, an unboxing or a GRWM. Then join a platform where brands post paid briefs. On TrendBag you sign up free, add two samples to your profile, take a 15-minute UGC basics lesson, and apply to fashion briefs. You do not need a large following to get started.

faq.q: How much should UGC creators charge in India?
faq.a: It depends on the deliverable, the effort involved and the usage rights the brand wants. A simple try-on Reel for organic posting usually pays less than a scripted video licensed for paid ads. On TrendBag, the brand sets the fee per brief, so you see it before you apply. As an example only, not a promise, fees could fall somewhere around ₹300–₹2,000 per video.

faq.q: Do I need followers to become a UGC creator?
faq.a: No. UGC is content that brands use on their own pages and ads, so they pay for the video rather than your audience. TrendBag has no follower minimum for UGC jobs. What matters is your profile: two strong samples, clear audio, good lighting and a verified badge from the UGC basics test brief help brands pick you.

faq.q: How do UGC creators get paid on TrendBag?
faq.a: Each brief is funded by the brand upfront. When you submit a video, the brand can approve it or ask for up to 2 rounds of revisions. Once approved, the fee is added to your balance in ₹. If the brand does not respond within 72 hours, the video is auto-approved. You can withdraw to a verified Indian bank account from ₹100.

faq.q: Who owns the UGC videos I make for brands?
faq.a: You keep ownership of your videos. The brand gets a licence to use each video as described in the brief, for example on its own Instagram page or in paid ads for a set period. Check the usage rights in a brief before applying, because wider rights usually mean the brand should pay more for the video.

faq.q: What is the difference between a UGC creator and an influencer?
faq.a: An influencer is paid mainly for reaching their own audience. A UGC creator is paid to make a video that the brand uses, often on its own account or in ads. That is why UGC creators do not need a big following. Many creators do both, and on TrendBag a video can also be posted by you with the brand as collaborator.

sections.heading: Why follower count alone misleads fashion brands

items.title: Size hides engagement
items.body: A large account can have weaker engagement than smaller creators of the same tier. Comparing against peers shows who actually holds attention.

items.title: Audience location matters
items.body: If you ship mostly to certain cities, a creator whose audience is elsewhere will not move sales, however big they are.

items.title: Sponsored fatigue is real
items.body: Some creators lose engagement on sponsored posts. Seeing that pattern early saves budget.

items.title: Delivery is part of quality
items.body: On-time delivery and low revision counts matter as much as reach when you run campaigns on a schedule.

faq.q: What is an influencer analytics tool?
faq.a: An influencer analytics tool shows how a creator's content and audience actually perform, beyond the follower count on their profile. It typically covers engagement, audience demographics, content niche and past brand work. TrendBag builds this from the creator's connected Instagram account and adds on-platform reliability, so Indian fashion brands can shortlist creators for a brief with evidence rather than guesswork.

faq.q: How do I check if an Instagram influencer has fake followers?
faq.a: Look for engagement that is far below creators of similar size, sudden follower jumps, and comments that are generic or repetitive. On TrendBag, creators who connect Instagram are run through authenticity checks, and the result is shown to brands as a risk level on the profile. For accounts not yet on TrendBag, the free creator audit gives a quick estimate from public data.

faq.q: What is a good engagement rate on Instagram in India?
faq.a: There is no single number that fits every account. Engagement rates tend to fall as follower count rises, so a rate that is strong for a large creator can be weak for a small one. Niche and language also shift the baseline. That is why TrendBag compares each creator's engagement with creators of the same size, and shows saves and shares alongside likes and comments.

faq.q: How can brands find fashion influencers in a specific city or language?
faq.a: Search by audience location and content language rather than by where the creator lives. TrendBag profiles include audience cities and the languages a creator posts in, such as Hindi, English, Hinglish or Tamil. When you post a brief, you can filter recommended creators by niche, city, language and follower tier to build a shortlist that matches your customers.

faq.q: Where does TrendBag's creator data come from?
faq.a: Profiles are built when a creator connects their Instagram account to TrendBag, which gives access to account-level insights that public pages do not show, such as audience breakdowns, saves and shares. Reliability data comes from the creator's work on TrendBag itself: approvals, on-time delivery, revisions and repeat hires. Profiles are refreshed regularly so you are not judging a creator on stale numbers.

faq.q: What are Instagram partnership ads?
faq.a: Instagram partnership ads are paid ads that run under both a creator's handle and a brand's handle, instead of only the brand's. They use content the creator made, such as a Reel, and carry a 'Paid partnership' label. Because the ad appears to come from a real person the audience may already follow, many brands use them to put proven creator content behind ad spend.

faq.q: How do I run partnership ads with an influencer?
faq.a: You need the creator's permission to run ads using their handle and content, and agreed usage rights. On TrendBag, you include paid usage in the brief, the creator grants partnership ad permission in one tap during the job, and you then boost the approved post from your own Meta ad account. Per-creator results are pulled back so you can compare performance.

faq.q: Does my ad spend go through TrendBag?
faq.a: No. Partnership ads run from your brand's own Meta ad account, so ad money never passes through TrendBag. You keep your own billing, payment method and Ads Manager access. TrendBag handles the creator side, including the brief, usage rights and permission, and pulls ad metrics back so you can see results for each creator in one place.

faq.q: What is hook rate in Instagram ads?
faq.a: Hook rate measures how well the opening of a video stops people from scrolling. It is calculated as 3-second video views divided by impressions. A video with a weak hook rarely recovers, however good the rest of it is. TrendBag shows hook rate alongside hold rate, CTR, CPA and ROAS for each creator, so you can see which openings work for your brand.

faq.q: Do partnership ads need a paid partnership label in India?
faq.a: ASCI guidelines expect paid collaborations between brands and creators to be clearly disclosed to viewers. Instagram's 'Paid partnership' label is the standard way to do that on the platform. TrendBag applies the label automatically to approved videos posted through a brief and to partnership ads, so disclosure does not depend on someone remembering to add it.

faq.q: How do I calculate Instagram engagement rate?
faq.a: A common way is to add the likes and comments on recent posts, divide by the number of posts to get an average, then divide that by the follower count and multiply by 100. The TrendBag creator audit does this for you from public data. Saves and shares are not public, so a full picture needs the creator's own account insights.

faq.q: What is a good engagement rate on Instagram in India?
faq.a: It depends heavily on account size and niche. Smaller creators usually see higher engagement rates than large ones, so the same percentage can be strong for one account and weak for another. Compare a creator with others of similar follower count in the same niche rather than with a fixed benchmark. TrendBag's full profiles make that same-size comparison for you.

faq.q: How can I check an influencer's fake followers for free?
faq.a: Start with engagement rate: an account with many followers but very few likes and comments is worth a closer look. Also check whether comments are generic and whether posting is consistent. The free TrendBag audit gives you an estimated engagement rate and posting rhythm from public data. Full authenticity checks run when a creator connects their account on TrendBag.

faq.q: Can I audit a personal Instagram account?
faq.a: No. The creator audit works only with public Instagram business or creator accounts, because those are the account types whose public data the audit can read. If a creator you want to work with uses a personal account, they can switch to a creator account in Instagram settings, or join TrendBag and connect their account for a full profile.

faq.q: Is the TrendBag creator audit free?
faq.a: Yes, the mini report is free. The audit is coming soon and will open first to brands on the early access list. It covers estimated engagement rate, niche, posting rhythm and brands tagged, all from public data. The full report, with reach, saves and audience, becomes available when the creator connects their Instagram account on TrendBag.
